content:
We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given only "sample of an organic molecule" but no data. Likely we need to use measurement tools to get spectra. We have many tools: mass spec, NMR, IR. We need to minimize experiments. Probably start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe NMR to deduce structure.

We need to decide a strategy: first get mass spec. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
